subject: Opsync: demo request / rebook options
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@opsync.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-09T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request: Redwood inference for Opsync

Hi Evelyn,

I signed up through the self-serve flow and selected a demo slot but wanted to reach out directly to add a bit more context. Opsync is building an orchestration layer for operations analytics — we have a handful of ML models in prod and are evaluating inference options to reduce latency and costs.

High level:
- 3 production services (1M tokens/day combined)
- Primarily open models, some fine-tuning planned
- Data residency: customer data stays in our VPC (we have questions about Private deployment)

Would love a focused 30m walkthrough of runtime characteristics (latency / batching / cost controls) and how Redwood handles private deployments. We are available Tues/Wed morning PT (May 11 preferred).

I attached a short requirements doc.

Thanks —
Olivia
Head of Platform, Opsync
[Attachment: opsync-requirements.docx (21 KB)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@opsync.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-09T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood inference for Opsync

Hi Olivia — great to meet you. Thanks for the context and the requirements doc.

I can do Tue May 11 at 9:00 AM PT or 11:00 AM PT — I'll send a calendar invite for the preferred slot once you confirm. If neither works, here is my quick booking link: https://calendly.com/evelyn-hart/30min.

Quick Q for your engineers: are you primarily targeting GPU-backed inference (GPUs in customer VPC) or will you want Redwood Private installed on-prem? That will help me tailor the demo.

Attaching a short product one-pager so the team has something to skim in advance.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@opsync.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: opsync-eng@opsync.ai
Date: 2026-05-09T18:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood inference for Opsync

Thanks, Evelyn — 9:00 AM PT on Tue May 11 works for us. I'll invite two engineers (cc'd). We are leaning GPU-in-VPC but open to discussing Private as a path if needed.

Can you share the one-pager and a short agenda so the engineers know what to expect?

—Olivia

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@opsync.ai>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quick note — missed meeting this morning

Hi Olivia —

I was on for our 9:00 AM PT demo but it looks like we missed each other. No problem — things happen. If you still want to run a quick 30m session this week, we're available Wed 10:00 AM PT or Thu 11:00 AM PT.

If it's easier, Dylan has a short recorded highlight (5m) we can send now and then pick a slot after you review.

Would you prefer a reschedule or the recording + async notes?

Best,
Evelyn

- Wed May 12, 10:00 AM PT
- Thu May 13, 9:30 AM PT or 10:00 AM PT

If none of those work, we can also do an async 10-minute recorded highlight focusing on latency and cost levers: https://loom.com/share/short-demo-opsync (clip + timestamps).

Attaching the proposal/prod-fit doc we referenced. If you can share the top 2 integration constraints (networking, token retention), we'll tailor the session.

Thanks —
